description: Transports en commun en Ile-de-France : messages d'alertes sur Twitter is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Nextérité. Selection of messages on Twitter about disruptions in public transport in Ile-de-France (RER, metro, tram) for the months of July, August and September 2018. Coverage: Nextérité. The portal shows the English title as "Public transport in Ile-de-France: alert messages on Twitter" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Nextérité. Its keywords include rer, tram, twitter, metro, ile-de-france, transport. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2018-10-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
